FR-001.title: Repository is named etalii.adp.ide.notion; the existing etalii-adp-ide-notion is renamed, no second one created

FR-002.title: Repository satisfies every rule in docs/new-repository.md

FR-003.title: First pull request adds the Build workflow with the terminology job

FR-004.title: Both build tables gain a row for etalii.adp.ide.notion

FR-005.title: Glossary lists Notion as a host, no longer requires a host to be an IDE, and defines Notion add-on

FR-006.title: CLAUDE.md and docs/new-repository.md in etalii.adp name the Notion repository

FR-008.title: Content served at https://etalii.net/adp/notion over HTTPS by GitHub Pages only

FR-009.title: The address serves an index of published add-ons with the published revision

FR-010.title: Each add-on has its own stable address under /adp/notion/

FR-011.title: A merge into develop publishes without a manual step; an unmerged pull request publishes nothing

FR-012.title: Notion and site publications never change or remove each other's pages

FR-013.title: A failed publication leaves the previous version in place and shows as a failed run

FR-014.title: Every page under /adp/notion is displayable as an embed inside a Notion page

FR-015.title: The site names Notion as a host with no tool available yet

expectations: No tool add-on is delivered by this feature
Where a Notion document's model is stored is not decided here
No Notion API integration or marketplace listing
